title.narrative: Support for the Data Insights for Social & Humanitarian Action Initiative (DISHA)

description.narrative: The Data Insights for Social & Humanitarian Action is an initiative managed by UNOPS and the Executive Office of the Secretary-General (EOSG) across the UN Global Pulse (UNGP) in collaboration with UN agencies (WFP, UNDP, private sector partners, and foundations). DISHA (previously called Global Data Access Initiative -GDAI), aspires to catalyze the formation of a connected and cohesive ecosystem of “plug-and-play” data and AI products and services including the responsible access to, use, and reuse of data thereby accelerating the attainment of the SDGs. DISHA is meant to build and deploy scalable, productionized solutions to problems faced by frontline organizations focusing on natural disaster response and recovery in close collaboration with, and informed by the needs of other UN agencies and Governments
